functionalRequirement: For any systematic action, such as disputes aging process, a case activity will be generated, and the user who initiated the dispute case must be notified upon next logon.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must generate a case activity for every systematic action, such as disputes aging process, and ensure that the user who initiated the dispute is notified upon their next logon.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to handle systematic actions and notify users, ensuring that all necessary activities are recorded and communicated.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must notify the user of the case activity within 5 seconds of their next logon.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Timely notification is crucial for user awareness and action, enhancing the user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must prevent duplicate notifications for the same case activity to the same user.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Avoiding duplicate notifications ensures a clean and user-friendly experience, reducing user confusion.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must handle cases where the user does not log on for an extended period (e.g., 30 days) and ensure that the notification is still delivered upon their next logon.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies that notifications should be reliable, even if the user is inactive for a long time.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must ensure that the notification content is encrypted during transmission and storage.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Notifications may contain sensitive information, and encryption is necessary to protect user data.

functionalRequirement: System shall read initialization data to derive definitions of heating and cooling units.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must accurately interpret and apply the definitions of heating and cooling units from the initialization data with 100% accuracy.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to correctly derive unit definitions, which are critical for the system's functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must read and apply initialization data within 2 seconds of system startup.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick initialization is important for a smooth user experience and system readiness.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The system must allow for easy updates to the initialization data without requiring a system restart.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The ability to update initialization data dynamically enhances the system's maintainability and flexibility.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Adaptability: The system must support multiple formats for initialization data (e.g., JSON, XML) and handle changes in the data structure gracefully.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Supporting multiple formats and adapting to changes ensures the system can evolve with new requirements.

functionalRequirement: The website shall provide forms for certificates so users can request certificates online.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must provide a form for each type of certificate that can be requested, ensuring all required fields are included.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to offer comprehensive forms for certificate requests, covering all necessary information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The system must provide clear instructions and examples for filling out the certificate request forms, ensuring that users can complete them without assistance.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Clear instructions improve the user experience and reduce the need for support.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must validate user inputs in real-time and provide immediate feedback on any errors or missing information.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Real-time validation helps users correct mistakes quickly, improving the form completion process.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure that all certificate requests are stored securely and cannot be tampered with after submission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Maintaining the integrity of certificate requests is crucial for trust and compliance.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to manage privacy settings such as who can view their profile, connections, and sharing data with third parties.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must provide a comprehensive set of privacy settings that allow users to control who can view their profile, connections, and data sharing with third parties.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to offer detailed privacy controls, ensuring users have granular control over their data.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Engagement: The system must provide a user-friendly interface for managing privacy settings, with clear labels and intuitive controls.
identifiedNFRs.justification: A user-friendly interface ensures that users can easily manage their privacy settings, enhancing their experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all user privacy settings and ensure that only the user and authorized administrators can access or modify them.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protecting privacy settings with encryption ensures that user data remains confidential.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Accountability: The system must log all changes to privacy settings, including the user who made the change and the timestamp.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Logging changes enhances accountability and helps in auditing and compliance.

functionalRequirement: System shall set over temperature values to prevent temperature deviations beyond 3 degrees Fahrenheit.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must accurately set and enforce over temperature values to prevent deviations beyond 3 degrees Fahrenheit with 100% accuracy.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to maintain precise temperature control, which is critical for the system's functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must detect and respond to temperature deviations within 1 second to prevent any over temperature conditions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick response to temperature deviations is essential for maintaining safe operating conditions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must have redundant temperature sensors and fail-safe mechanisms to ensure that temperature control is maintained even in the event of a single point of failure.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Redundancy and fail-safes are necessary to ensure reliable temperature control and prevent system failures.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operational Constraint: The system must shut down all heating and cooling units if the temperature exceeds the over temperature threshold by more than 5 degrees Fahrenheit.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Shutting down the system in extreme conditions is a safety measure to prevent damage or hazards.
